plan.title: Treatment x time interaction in 12-sample bulk RNA-seq
plan.analytical_narrative:
The research question — does the treatment effect differ between the two time points — is exactly an interaction question on a 2x2 design: 2 conditions x 2 time points (t0, t1), 3 replicates per cell, 12 samples, single batch. The inputs are a raw integer gene-level count matrix from Salmon (12000 genes x 12 sample columns, first column gene symbol, /eval-full-32-with-two-timepoints-n3-2/data/inputs/counts/counts.csv) and a 12x4 sample table carrying condition, time and time_hours (/eval-full-32-with-two-timepoints-n3-2/data/inputs/metadata/metadata.csv).

The plan follows the Inflexa procedure for a bulk RNA-seq interaction question on counts (snapshot sha256:ad61b0ba...). T1S1 runs sample-structure QC first — blind VST, PCA on the 500 most variable genes, sample-distance heatmap, library sizes — coloured by condition and time, because with 3 replicates per cell one aberrant sample can drive the whole interaction. T1S2 fits one DESeq2 model, ~ condition + time + condition:time, with reference levels set explicitly (the untreated/control level of condition and t0 of time, as read from metadata.csv, both reported), a minimal pre-filter (>=10 counts in >=3 samples, the smallest cell size) and median-of-ratios size factors inside the model. The primary test is the Wald test on the condition:time interaction coefficient; the simple effects (treatment vs control at t0, and at t1 via the sum of the main effect and the interaction) are extracted at the same threshold and reported beside it. Counts are already summarised to gene level, so tximport length offsets cannot be applied — the step must state this deviation. T1S3 is a robustness check: the same design and contrasts through edgeR's quasi-likelihood F-test, reporting per-method counts and the intersection as the high-confidence set, not the union. Because the interaction coefficient is a difference of two differences at n=3 per cell, its standard error is larger than that of a main effect and power is low; the threshold is NOT loosened to compensate, and the absence of a gene from the interaction list is not evidence that its treatment effect is the same at both time points.

T2S1 runs fgsea preranked GSEA separately per contrast (interaction, simple effect at t0, simple effect at t1) on the full ranked list of tested genes, ranked by the DESeq2 Wald statistic — the stated choice on the disputed ranking-metric rule, taken because it is signed and scaled by its own standard error, unlike an unshrunken fold change or a saturating signed p-value. Human hallmark gene sets are the first collection and human GO biological process the follow-up; the reference store holds both as HGNC-symbol GMTs, and the Reactome C2:CP subset the procedure names as the preferred second collection is NOT staged, so GO BP substitutes and the step must say so. Enrichment on the interaction ranking is exploratory: the interaction statistic is noisy at this replicate number, and a set that scores there is a hypothesis, not a finding. T1S4 assembles the report: the three effect columns per gene (unshrunken log2FC, ashr-shrunken log2FC, lfcSE) with genes ranked on the shrunken value, MA and dispersion plots, p-value histograms per contrast, the count of genes with NA p-values from the Cook's-distance outlier flag separated from those the independent filter removed, the explicit power statement at 3 replicates, and the full reproducibility record.

Benjamini-Hochberg with DESeq2 independent filtering, within contrast
fgsea preranked GSEA on the DESeq2 Wald statistic, per contrast, Hallmark then GO BP
Interaction report: simple effects at t0 and t1 beside the interaction contrast, MA and dispersion plots, p-value histograms, power statement, session info

acceptance_criteria: Three separate fgsea runs, one per contrast, each on the FULL ranked list of tested genes — no significance cutoff applied before ranking
Ranking metric is the DESeq2 Wald statistic (stat), stated explicitly in the output
Gene set size window 15-500 after intersection with the tested genes; collection name and version reported
BH-adjusted p-values within each contrast and collection; significant sets collapsed to non-redundant representatives with the full table kept as a supplement
Leading-edge genes listed per significant set with their Wald statistic, and leading-edge overlap between reported sets marked
Percentage of tested gene symbols not matching the collection is reported
A random seed is set and recorded for the permutation step
If a collection is unavailable at run time, the step reports that plainly and does not substitute a non-human collection
constraints: Rank on the Wald statistic — this is the stated choice on the disputed ranking-metric question, taken because it is signed and scaled by its standard error, unlike the unshrunken fold change or a saturating signed p-value
Never cut the ranked list at a p-value or fold-change threshold before running fgsea
Run enrichment once per contrast; never pool genes across contrasts into one list
Universe is the set of genes tested in T1S2
Use human gene set collections only — hallmark first, GO biological process as the follow-up
Set and record the permutation seed
caveats: The interaction Wald statistic is noisy at 3 replicates per cell; a set enriched on the interaction ranking is a hypothesis for follow-up, not an established finding
Enrichment results depend strongly on the method and collection — report the method and do not treat one result as truth
GO BP is a nested hierarchy: parent and child sets overlap heavily, so significant hits arrive in correlated blocks and must be collapsed before any count is reported
Reactome, the procedure's preferred second human collection, is not present in the reference store; the GO BP substitution must be stated in the output

grounding.reason: Ranked GSEA on the full tested list per contrast (R-0107, R-0104, R-0045), hallmark first for human (R-0048); disputed rule R-0108 resolved in favour of the Wald statistic, stated here. Reactome (R-0098) is not staged, so GO BP substitutes with the deviation reported.

steps.name: Interaction report and reproducibility record
steps.question: Does the treatment effect differ between t0 and t1 — and what does this 2x2 design with 3 replicates per cell actually license as a conclusion?
steps.description: Assemble the final report. For every gene of interest present the three results side by side: treatment effect at t0, treatment effect at t1, and the interaction contrast that is their difference, each with unshrunken log2FoldChange, ashr-shrunken log2FoldChange, lfcSE and padj, ranked on the shrunken value. Name the reference level of condition and of time beside the tables, since every coefficient's meaning depends on them. Include the MA plot and dispersion plot from T1S2, the per-contrast p-value histograms, the DESeq2/edgeR overlap from T1S3, and the GSEA tables with leading-edge genes and collection versions from T2S1. State the expected power at 3 replicates per cell explicitly, before the gene tables, and state that the interaction term's power is lower still. Attach sessionInfo, package versions, the permutation seed, and the gene set collection versions.
steps.context: The honest headline may well be that few or no genes reach significance on the interaction at n=3 per cell. That is a result, and it must be reported as low power rather than dressed up by a loosened threshold or by presenting simple effects as if they answered the interaction question.
acceptance_criteria: Interaction contrast and both simple effects are presented side by side per gene, with the reference level of condition and of time named beside the tables
Gene ranking and plots use the shrunken log2 fold change; p-values come from the unshrunken fit
Method, package versions, design formula, every contrast, the thresholds, the number of genes tested and the number of DE genes per contrast are stated before the gene tables
An explicit power statement at 3 replicates per cell appears before the gene tables, including that a gene absent from the interaction list is not shown to have equal effects at t0 and t1
DESeq2/edgeR overlap per contrast is reported with the intersection as the high-confidence set

Enrichment section names the collection, its version, the Wald ranking metric, the universe, the 15-500 size window, and lists leading-edge genes per significant set, with the method-dependence caveat
Reproducibility record — sessionInfo, package versions, permutation seed, collection versions — is stored with the results
If the interaction yields no significant genes, the report says so directly and does not substitute the simple effects as an answer to the interaction question
constraints: Report the unshrunken log2FoldChange, the ashr-shrunken log2FoldChange, and lfcSE for every gene; rank and plot on the shrunken value only
Do not present the union of DESeq2 and edgeR calls as the result
Do not restate an exploratory enrichment hit as an established mechanism
Store the reproducibility record with the results, not as a separate note
caveats: 12 samples, 3 per design cell: every conclusion here is provisional and the interaction test in particular is underpowered
The 12000-gene matrix is a subset of the transcriptome; absent genes were not tested, not shown to be unchanged

grounding.reason: Interaction design report: simple effects beside the interaction contrast (R-0092), power statement at 3 replicates (R-0094), two-method overlap (R-0042), shrunken and unshrunken effects (R-0085), fit diagnostics (R-0087), and the full reproducibility record (R-0086).
